parsed.faithful: BYRLAW, or Byrlaw laws, in Scotland, are made and determined by neighbours, elected by common consent in byrlaw courts. The men chosen as judges, are called byrlaw or barlaw men, and take cognizance of complaints between neighbour and neighbour.
